task_title: Selftest gate spends ~85% of CPU on full node-provision runs that assert a single layer
task_criteria: 1. project-node.sh accepts --layers 20,40 and rejects an unknown layer with exit 2 and usage text. 2. A scoped run prints a SCOPE line and SKIP rows for unnamed layers, and never writes .node/node.json. 3. Unscoped behaviour unchanged: bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS with 34 PASS rows and the real provision still prints 3 FAIL rows -> NODE: FAIL (3). 4. Fixtures 4/4b/14/15 use --layers and their exact-row assertions are unchanged. 5. Measured: selftest user+sys below 1.2 s on three consecutive runs, from 2.49 s measured at d5f7fb2.
